title: Samsung details the new Warranty and care menu in One UI 9
description: One UI 9, which made its debut on the recently launched Galaxy Z Fold8, Fold8 Ultra, and Flip8, brings with it a new Warranty and care menu in Settings. It is here that you can keep track of your warranty periods and expiration dates across all of your Samsung devices, with the information being consolidated into one place. The device in use is displayed at the top of the screen, including its eligibility for enrollment into Samsung Care+. Below this device you'll find all the others that are linked to your Samsung account, the one you're signed in with. Bixby can be used...

title: Apple is losing the antitrust battle and soon won't be able to charge commissions from external payment platforms
description: Apple has been fighting antitrust regulators across the globe, and it's about to lose yet another battle in the US after trying to make commissions from purchases made on third-party payment platforms. But in the latest regulatory filing from Apple itself, the company admits that it may no longer be able to do so. The EU Commission was the first to force Apple to allow third-party app stores on its platform since the company's official App Store charges a 30% commission on each purchase, including in-app purchases. This way, creators can't distribute their content anywhere else and are...

title: Samsung Wallet adds Digital Key support for Volkswagen EVs
description: Today Samsung has announced that Samsung Wallet now supports Digital Key access for Volkswagen EVs, including the ID. Polo, ID. Cross, ID.3neo, ID.4, ID.5, ID.7, and ID. Buzz. This is currently rolling out in Europe for vehicles running ID. software version 6.0.1. Only vehicles produced on or after April 27, 2026 are compatible, and they need to be equipped with the "Preparation for Digital Key" option package. Through this feature you can use a compatible Samsung Galaxy smartphone to lock, unlock, and start your car without having to use a physical key. Digital Keys in Samsung...

title: iQOO Neo11 Ultra and Z11S debut in China
description: As expected, iQOO announced its Neo11 Ultra and Z11S in China today. Both phones come with MediaTek Dimensity chipsets and massive batteries while also boasting IP68/IP69 ingress protection. iQOO Neo11 Ultra Neo11 Ultra is equipped with the Dimensity 9500 Monster chipset, which is paired with iQOO’s Q2 gaming chip and up to 16GB LPDDR5X Ultra RAM and 512GB UFS 4.1 storage. Z11S gets the Dimensity 7500 paired with LPDDR4X RAM and UFS 3.1 storage. Both phones feature sizeable Si-C batteries with a 9,100mAh cell on the Neo 11 Ultra and an even larger 10,000mAh power pack on the...

title: Poco M8x 5G's battery details revealed ahead of launch
description: Earlier this month, Poco launched the M8 Power in India with an 8,000mAh battery. The company then began teasing the M8x 5G in the country late last week. Now, Poco has revealed the battery capacity of the upcoming M8-series smartphone. The Poco M8x 5G will pack a 7,900mAh battery, the company confirmed via an official X post. It will also support 45W wired charging and 22.5W reverse wired charging. Poco confirmed yesterday that the M8x 5G will launch in India on August 21, while also revealing several key specifications. The smartphone will be powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5...

title: The slim Moto Pad 70 is now available in India, here's how much it costs
description: A couple of weeks ago, Motorola unveiled the Moto Pad 70, which became the third member of the Pad 70 family. It is similar to the Moto Pad 70 Groove, which also has a 12.1” IPS LCD (but it’s 120Hz instead of 90Hz) – the main difference between these two is that the Groove packs a 9-unit JBL Pro Speaker System with a built-in kickstand on its back. Moto Pad 70 There are a few other differences, but the big news today is that the slimmer Pad 70 is now available in India. You can find it on Motorola.in as well as on Flipkart. Flipkart only has the 8/256GB model and it is priced...

title: CMF's new wireless earbuds will be unveiled on August 20
description: After announcing the CMF Clip Pro earbuds earlier this month and teasing a new product recently, Nothing sub-brand CMF has now confirmed that it’s unveiling the Buds Neo later this week. In a post on X, CMF by Nothing announced that the Buds Neo will be unveiled on August 20. A teaser video shared alongside the announcement offers a first look at the charging case, which appears to feature a smart dial similar to those found on other CMF audio products. The video also reveals the earbuds' color options. Buds Neo.20 August. pic.twitter.com/ZjfWxscOXE— CMF by Nothing...

title: Fairphone 6+ is now official and coming to the US
description: Fairphone has today announced its latest smartphone, the Fairphone 6+. It comes with 50% more RAM than the Fairphone 6 at 12GB vs. 8GB, and the newer Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 SoC. It's available in a new Cobalt Blue color, along with Forest Green and Horizon Black. These are the only changes from the Fairphone 6. Fairphone 6+ official images For the first time ever, a Fairphone device will be officially available in the US, from both Fairphone's online store and Amazon, with no caveats about it not running Android. However, make sure you check its compatibility with your carrier...

title: Samsung Poland lists 7 SKUs for the Galaxy S26 FE
description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE is on a roll – yesterday, the phone appeared on the Google Play Console and in a hands-on video. Now, the FE model has been listed in an official Samsung document. The PDF in question comes from Samsung Poland and concerns the terms and conditions for Samsung Care+, the company’s extra insurance plan. The document doesn’t reveal much, but it does list 7 model numbers for the Galaxy S26 FE. An official Samsung Care+ PDF reveals seven model numbers for the Galaxy S26 FE So far, we’ve seen leaked renders that show three color options. Assuming there are two...

title: The Tecno Pova 8 Pro is now up on Flipkart, will launch in India later this week
description: Tecno unveiled the Pova 8 Pro last week, but the company kept launch details under wraps, saying only that it will debut in India on August 18 – that’s today! But no, the phone isn’t available yet. Sales in India will start on August 21 (Friday). Tecno has partnered with Flipkart to launch the phone and you can already visit the store pages and set up a notification to remind you on Friday. The 8/256GB model is priced ₹50,000 and the 12/512GB variant is ₹55,000. Note that there is a ₹3,000 instant cashback and no-cost EMI up to 18 months. The Tecno Pova 8 Pro comes in three...

title: Honor Pad 20 Pro announced with SD 8s Gen 4 and 10,100 mAh battery
description: The Honor Pad 20 made its debut back in May, and it is now getting a Pro counterpart with bumped-up specs. Honor Pad 20 Pro brings a more capable Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset alongside a 10,100mAh battery and a 12.1-inch IPS LCD. The panel offers 3K resolution (3,000 x 1,872px) with a 165Hz refresh rate and supports stylus input via the optional Honor Magic-Pencil 4s. Honor is also offering a Paperlike Edition of the Pad 20 Pro, which brings an anti-glare display for a more intuitive drawing and note-taking experience. Both versions of the Pad 20 Pro feature up to 700 nits peak...

title: Honor Robot Phone is now available in China
description: Following its announcement last week, Honor opened up the first round of open sales for the Robot Phone in China. The highly anticipated smartphone with a 200MP gimbal camera is now available from Honor’s official online store and partnering retailers with a starting price of CNY 9,999 for the 12/512GB trim. Based on today’s exchange rates, that amounts to about $1,483 or €1,281. Honor is also offering a 16GB RAM and 1TB storage version for CNY 12,999 ($1,928/€1,666). Honor confirmed the Robot Phone won't be available for purchase outside its homeland even though last week's...

title: iQOO reveals more details about the Indian Z11 and Buds TWS ahead of launch
description: iQOO will introduce the Z11 in India on August 20, with a design and specs different from the Chinese and Malaysian Z11. iQOO has already revealed a few features of the Indian Z11, and it has now shared more details about the smartphone. iQOO has revealed that the Indian Z11 will sport a 32MP selfie camera on the front, while the dual-camera setup on the rear will comprise a 50MP primary (Sony IMX882, OIS, 26mm) and an 8MP (15mm) ultrawide-angle camera. Additionally, iQOO announced that the Indian Z11 will get three years of Android OS upgrades and five years of security updates,...

description: Apple has been rumored to be working on AirPods with built-in cameras for some time now. Despite a recent rumor claiming that the so-called AirPods Ultra project has been cancelled, a new video has surfaced showing the camera-equipped AirPods in action. The demo video for the camera-equipped AirPods was discovered by MacRumors in the latest macOS 26.7 release candidate. description: Nothing's sub-brand CMF may not be launching a new smartphone this year, but it is still busy working on other products. And it now looks like the next one we're getting will be a new pair of earbuds. At least that's what the company's new teaser, seen below, strongly hints at. title: Google's Scam Detection feature is headed to another Android device maker
description: Google's Scam Detection can warn you of potential scams during phone calls, and so far it's been available for Pixels of course, but also Samsung flagships since the Galaxy S26 series. However, it turns out that the feature is probably headed to a third Android brand: vivo. According to a new report based on a teardown of the latest Phone by Google app, vivo phones should be next in line to support Scam Detection. title: vivo V80 Lite 5G teaser image shows part of its front design
description: Earlier this month we heard that vivo was working on the V80 Lite 5G, and its listing on the Google Play Console revealed that it's most likely a rebranded vivo S2. Today on Instagram the image you can see below was posted by a multi-brand mobile store in Shajapur, India. It shows a little bit of the device's front design, though the image seems to be heavily embellished, so to speak. The screen is clearly curved, that's for sure, and there's a hole punch cutout for the selfie camera in the center. The V80 Lite 5G's slogan could be "slay every edge", as the image reveals. title: HMD 102 4G Pro specs leak
description: HMD launched the 102 4G back in September of last year and now the company seems to be working on an upgraded version called the 102 4G Pro. This has been leaked today by a usually reliable source of HMD-related information. According to said source, the new device will have a 2" QQVGA LCD screen, a 0.3MP camera, the Unisoc 8910FF-S chipset, 24MB of RAM, 48MB of internal storage, support for 32GB microSD cards, and a 1,200 mAh battery which charges via USB-C. title: Motorola Edge 70 Max in for review
description: This is the Motorola Edge 70 Max, which launched last month. Let's take a look inside it box and see what it's about. The Edge 70 Max ships with 256GB of storage and either 8GB or 12GB of RAM. You can get it in Pantone Aqua Gray, Pantone Ice Melt, and Pantone Dark Shadow (our model), each with a unique-feeling texture. Prices are €750, £700, or INR 59,999. Unboxing the Motorola Edge 70 Max You get the usual cable and case in the box. The case isn't MagSafe-compatible, which is a shame, as we've seen lower-tier Motos with a MagSafe case in the box.
